svg.title: ARC-AGI-1 / Semi-Private: score versus cost by effort
svg.desc: X: USD per task, logarithmic. Y: native ARC-AGI-1 / Semi-Private percentage score, zero to 100. Each point is an exact published model and effort configuration. Label leaders do not move the underlying measured points. No Artificial Analysis scores are mixed in.
svg.text: Same benchmark, same published model configuration for both score and cost. Upper-left is better.
X = benchmark cost per task (USD, log scale) Y = native benchmark score (%)
Not an Intelligence Index score. Different benchmarks have different tasks, harnesses, and cost distributions.
Average USD cost per task / logarithmic scale / lower is cheaper
No confidence intervals in these captured rows. Close scores are not a decisive ranking.
